title: Rules
description: Limits checked before a tool runs, and guidance for every chat.
place.noFolders: No folder listed yet: choose Another folder… to enter one.
place.noFolder: Pick or enter a folder to see its rules.
kind.limit.hint: Stops a tool call the safety checker judges to break the rule.
kind.check_in.hint: Asks you first when the safety checker judges a tool call matches the rule.
kind.guidance.hint: Advice the agent reads. It blocks nothing.
kind.playbook.hint: Steps the agent is told to follow. It blocks nothing.
applies.judged: Tool calls the checker judges (read-only tools only when named)
caps.label: Rules saved in each place
caps: {{checked}} of 32 limits and check-ins, {{prompt}} of 32 guidance and playbooks
empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: Add a rule to limit what agents may do or to guide how they work.
empty.partial.title: No rules received
empty.partial.body: This list may not be complete, so this place may still hold rules.
waiting: A change is waiting to be checked. Check it, or stop tracking it, first.
readonly.incomplete: These rules are read only: this list may not be complete, and a change replaces the whole list.
readonly.no_revision: These rules are read only: the agent did not say which version of this list it sent, so a change could not be checked against it.
readonly.unplaced: These rules are read only: this agent does not say which settings file each rule is in, so a change could overwrite the wrong one. Update the agent to edit them.
readonly.folder: These rules are read only: they belong to a different folder than the one shown.
grants.label: Command access already granted (kept as it is)
dlg.textHint: What the agent should or must not do, in a sentence or two.
dlg.toolsHint: With none chosen, the rule covers the tool calls the checker judges. Read-only tools count only when you name them; the Bot's own control tools never do.
dlg.agentsHint: With none chosen, the rule covers every agent.
dlg.namesHint: Pick from the list, or type a name and press Enter.
dlg.where: Where it is saved and the limits
problem.id: This rule's name is not valid.
problem.text_control: A rule cannot hold control characters.
problem.text_lines: Write the rule as one line: remove the line breaks and tabs.
problem.text_format: Guidance and playbooks cannot hold invisible characters (a joined emoji has one). Remove them, or type the text again.
problem.tools_prompt: Guidance and playbooks are advice, not tied to tools: clear the tools, or choose a limit or check-in.
problem.tool_name: Tool names use letters, numbers and underscores only.
problem.agent_name: Agent names use lower-case letters, numbers, dashes and underscores, each once.
problem.duplicate: This list already has a rule with that name.
problem.cap_checked: This place already holds 32 limits and check-ins.
problem.cap_prompt: This place already holds 32 guidance and playbook rules.
rm.title: Remove this rule?
rm.effect: The agent stops following it in every chat that reads {{scope}}.
rm.effect2: The other rules saved there stay as they are.
saved: Rules saved. This is the list the agent reports now.
held: Saving rules ({{scope}}) may have gone through. Check again reads the rules; nothing is sent again.
stop.title: Stop tracking this change?
stop.effect: It may still have gone through. Read the rules again before you change them.
refused.revision_conflict: These rules changed since this page read them, so nothing was saved. The list now shown is the current one. Make your change again.
refused.write_intent_invalid: The agent did not accept this request: its one-time permission had expired or been used. Nothing was changed. Try again.
refused.bad_request: The agent did not accept this list, so nothing was changed. Details says why.
notsent.SETTINGS_SCOPE: Pick one realm and a folder first. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_NOT_READY: The agent on this computer is not signed in as you yet, so the settings chat could not open. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_REFUSED: The agent would not open the settings chat. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_UNKNOWN: The settings chat may not have opened, and nothing was changed. Try again; a chat left over closes itself.
notsent.SETTINGS_BINDING: The settings chat opened somewhere other than expected and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LEASE: The settings chat could not be kept open and was closed. Nothing was changed.
notsent.NOT_EDITABLE: These rules changed and can no longer be edited here. Nothing was sent.
notsent.SETTINGS_SUPERSEDED: You moved to another place before the chat opened. Nothing was changed.
notsent.SETTINGS_LOST: The settings chat was lost twice. Nothing was changed. Try again.
notsent.NONCE_UNREADABLE: The agent's one-time permission could not be read. Nothing was changed. Try again.
when.unreadable: Has a condition this page cannot show, so the rules saved with it are read only here.
readonly.when: These rules are read only: one has a condition this page cannot carry whole, and a change replaces the whole list, which would drop it.
readonly.reasonShort.when: A condition this page cannot carry
problem.when_prompt: This rule runs only when a condition holds, and only limits and check-ins take one: keep it a limit or check-in.
notsent.CAPABILITY_MISSING: These rules include a condition, and the agent on this computer does not support conditions, so it would drop it. Update the agent. Nothing was sent.
caps.note: In this realm: {{checked}} of 32 limits and check-ins, {{prompt}} of 32 guidance and playbooks.
unreadable: The agent's answer could not be read as a whole. Nothing is shown, so nothing can be replaced by mistake.
